verdict.rationale: The vuejs/core GitHub repository states that Vue.js is an MIT-licensed open source project. The source is publicly hosted on GitHub, where users open issues and submit pull requests, so the source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the license terms beyond the repository's own statement.
